name: Charlotte
description: A determined reporter who pursues the truth with bold curiosity. Charlotte's investigative instincts make her both fearless and resourceful in gathering information.

name: Chevreuse
description: A disciplined captain known for her strict professionalism and excellent marksmanship. Chevreuse leads her patrols with confidence and unwavering resolve.

name: Clorinde
description: A famed champion duelist who moves with unparalleled precision. Clorinde’s calm focus conceals intense inner determination and a tireless sense of duty.

name: Emilie
description: A poised perfumer whose creations blend art with botanical mastery. Emilie examines the emotional and symbolic weight of scents with delicate insight.

name: Escoffier
description: A dignified gourmand who views cooking as a craft of precision and artistry. Escoffier approaches every recipe like a scientific formula, seeking perfection in flavor.

name: Freminet
description: A quiet diver who prefers solitude beneath the waves. Freminet is gentle but often misunderstood, channeling his emotions into precise mechanical craftsmanship.

name: Furina
description: A dramatic and expressive performer whose flair captures the hearts of Fontaine. Beneath her theatrical exterior lies deep introspection and empathy.

name: Lynette
description: A quiet magician’s assistant who moves with refined grace. Lynette prefers subtlety and efficiency, using her abilities to support from the shadows.

name: Lyney
description: A charismatic illusionist who dazzles audiences with fiery displays and clever misdirection. Lyney’s charm conceals a sharp mind and carefully measured intentions.

name: Navia
description: A spirited and compassionate leader who faces hardship with elegance and courage. Navia guides her allies with warmth while carrying her responsibilities with grace.

name: Neuvillette
description: An enigmatic figure who holds immense authority and speaks with solemn clarity. Neuvillette values fairness and carries deep respect for the laws of nature.

name: Sigewinne
description: A small but dependable medical officer known for her gentle demeanor. Sigewinne supports others with boundless care while maintaining surprising determination.

name: Wriothesley
description: The overseer of a remote penitentiary who maintains firm discipline while valuing fairness. Wriothesley acts with calm authority, navigating conflicts with strategic composure.
